steps.en: Add the React workbook component to your app
steps.zh: 给应用装上 React 工作簿组件

steps.en: Render a Workbook into a sized container div
steps.zh: 在有尺寸的容器 div 里渲染 Workbook

steps.en: Draws the Excel-like grid: formulas, merges, conditional formatting
steps.zh: 画出类 Excel 网格：公式、合并、条件格式

steps.en: Subscribe to the change stream to persist or broadcast edits
steps.zh: 订阅变更流，把编辑落库或广播

steps.en: Emits a structured op array describing each edit
steps.zh: 为每次编辑吐出结构化 op 数组

steps.en: Point ops at your storage — Express + MongoDB demo included
steps.zh: 把 op 接到你的存储——仓库自带 Express + MongoDB 示例

value.en: An editable Excel-like grid inside your React app while storage and collaboration stay your own stack — no vendor server
value.zh: React 应用里多了一张可编辑的类 Excel 网格，存储与协同仍是你自己的栈——没有厂商服务器

sources: https://github.com/ruilisi/fortune-sheet/blob/master/README.md — install line `npm install @fortune-sheet/react`; JSX sample `<Workbook data={[{ name: "Sheet1" }]} />`; 'an array of Op will be emiited through onOp callback'; backend demo 'Run it with node index.js' (fetched 2026-09-27)
